title: Tricycle driver shot dead by a motorcycle-riding gunman in Dicalungan, Ampatuan
summary: Tricycle driver Hashim Buyogan Hadji Esmael was shot dead on the morning of Monday, 26 October 2026, in Barangay Dicalungan, Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur. Witnesses told police that one of two men riding a motorcycle shot him in the head as they came up to his tricycle, and the pair sped away.

title: Two men on a motorcycle ambushed and killed on the highway in Iganagampong, Datu Unsay
summary: Munsari Abpi and Usop Ugod, riding together on a motorcycle, were ambushed by gunmen on a highway in Barangay Iganagampong, Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur, on the night of Sunday, 25 October 2026. Both died instantly; the attackers fled and left them beside the concrete road, according to Capt. Steffie Salanguit, spokesperson for the Police Regional Office-BAR.

title: Barangay councilor shot dead outside his store in Macabiso, Sultan Mastura
summary: Saddam Barra, a member of the barangay council of Macabiso, Sultan Mastura, Maguindanao del Norte, was shot dead by two armed men in front of his roadside store on the morning of Saturday, 24 October 2026. The gunmen escaped on a motorcycle.

title: Motorcycle rider shot dead by gunmen in a minivan in Nabalawag
summary: Alex Talungon was shot dead with pistols by gunmen aboard a minivan who came up behind him on a secluded stretch of highway in Barangay Nabalawag, Nabalawag, in the Special Geographic Area, on Saturday, 24 October 2026, as he rode his motorcycle toward the town centre. He died instantly from multiple gunshot wounds, according to local officials and the town police.
